sources.title: ihhelsinki.fi
highlights: If you are in Finland working and receiving pay, or if you are an entrepreneur, you will need a Finnish tax card
You can call the Tax Administration’s telephone service at +358 29 497 010 (Mon–Fri, 9–16) to book an appointment to get a Finnish personal identity code and a tax card at the same time
A valid passport or identity card
An estimation of your total annual income including wage income and possible fringe benefits, holiday pay, bonuses etc
